verdict.rationale: Supermemory auto-builds user profiles ('comprehensive user info always ready'), a living knowledge graph of facts, and surfaces related memories on search (relatedMemories: true), which are AI-generated insight/suggestion-like outputs derived from stored data rather than raw retrieval. However, these are framed as memory/context primitives for downstream LLM use rather than the product itself generating proactive insights, summaries, or recommendations to the end user, and no evidence shows a UI or feature that surfaces such generated insights directly. missing for 10: first-party evidence of proactive insight/suggestion generation (e.g., summaries, recommendations, trend detection) surfaced to the user, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this behavior beyond docs.
